import hashlib
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

TODO_PY = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "todo.py")

SCENARIO_TESTS = [
    "test_ac1_add_then_list_format",
    "test_ac2_complete_marks_done",
    "test_ac3_id_stability_never_reused",
    "test_ac4_unknown_complete_id",
    "test_ac5_malformed_store_safe_failure",
]


def run_todo(cwd, *args):
    return subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, TODO_PY] + list(args),
        cwd=cwd,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        text=True,
    )


def read_store(cwd):
    with open(os.path.join(cwd, "todos.json"), "rb") as fh:
        return fh.read()


class TodoCliTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_ac1_add_then_list_format(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as cwd:
            added = run_todo(cwd, "add", "buy milk")
            self.assertEqual(added.returncode, 0, added.stderr)
            listed = run_todo(cwd, "list")
            self.assertEqual(listed.returncode, 0, listed.stderr)
            self.assertEqual(listed.stdout, "1 buy milk [open]\n")

    def test_ac2_complete_marks_done(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as cwd:
            added = run_todo(cwd, "add", "buy milk")
            self.assertEqual(added.returncode, 0, added.stderr)
            completed = run_todo(cwd, "complete", "1")
            self.assertEqual(completed.returncode, 0, completed.stderr)
            listed = run_todo(cwd, "list")
            self.assertEqual(listed.returncode, 0, listed.stderr)
            self.assertEqual(listed.stdout, "1 buy milk [done]\n")

    def test_ac3_id_stability_never_reused(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as cwd:
            first = run_todo(cwd, "add", "buy milk")
            self.assertEqual(first.returncode, 0, first.stderr)
            second = run_todo(cwd, "add", "walk dog")
            self.assertEqual(second.returncode, 0, second.stderr)
            listed = run_todo(cwd, "list")
            self.assertEqual(listed.returncode, 0, listed.stderr)
            lines = listed.stdout.splitlines()
            self.assertIn("1 buy milk [open]", lines)
            self.assertIn("2 walk dog [open]", lines)
            third = run_todo(cwd, "add", "wash dishes")
            self.assertEqual(third.returncode, 0, third.stderr)
            listed = run_todo(cwd, "list")
            self.assertEqual(listed.returncode, 0, listed.stderr)
            self.assertIn("3 wash dishes [open]", listed.stdout.splitlines())
            completed = run_todo(cwd, "complete", "1")
            self.assertEqual(completed.returncode, 0, completed.stderr)
            fourth = run_todo(cwd, "add", "nap")
            self.assertEqual(fourth.returncode, 0, fourth.stderr)
            listed = run_todo(cwd, "list")
            self.assertEqual(listed.returncode, 0, listed.stderr)
            lines = listed.stdout.splitlines()
            self.assertIn("4 nap [open]", lines)
            self.assertNotIn("1 nap [open]", lines)

    def test_ac4_unknown_complete_id(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as cwd:
            added = run_todo(cwd, "add", "buy milk")
            self.assertEqual(added.returncode, 0, added.stderr)
            before = read_store(cwd)
            before_sha = hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest()
            completed = run_todo(cwd, "complete", "999")
            self.assertNotEqual(completed.returncode, 0)
            after = read_store(cwd)
            self.assertEqual(hashlib.sha256(after).hexdigest(), before_sha)
            self.assertEqual(after, before)

    def test_ac5_malformed_store_safe_failure(self):
        malformed = b"{not json"
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as cwd:
            seeded = run_todo(cwd, "add", "seed")
            self.assertEqual(seeded.returncode, 0, seeded.stderr)
            with open(os.path.join(cwd, "todos.json"), "wb") as fh:
                fh.write(malformed)
            for args in (("add", "x"), ("list",), ("complete", "1")):
                result = run_todo(cwd, *args)
                self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0, args)
                self.assertEqual(read_store(cwd), malformed, args)

    def test_ac8_regression_suite_runs(self):
        if os.environ.get("TODO_AC8_REENTRY") == "1":
            for name in SCENARIO_TESTS:
                self.assertTrue(callable(getattr(TodoCliTests, name, None)))
            return
        env = dict(os.environ)
        env["TODO_AC8_REENTRY"] = "1"
        root = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
        proc = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, "-m", "unittest", "test_todo", "-v"],
            cwd=root,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
            text=True,
            env=env,
        )
        out = proc.stdout + proc.stderr
        self.assertEqual(proc.returncode, 0, out)
        for name in SCENARIO_TESTS:
            self.assertIn(name, out)
        self.assertRegex(out, r"Ran [1-9][0-9]* tests? in ")
        self.assertRegex(out, r"\nOK(\s|\n|$)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
